scenarios: A research team finalizing a Phase 3 vaccine trial needs to submit clinical study data to ImmPort, requiring alignment with NIAID Blueprint Section 1 for metadata elements like study type and intervention description.

Investigators generating bulk RNA-seq data from infected lung tissue plan to deposit records in the Gene Expression Omnibus, necessitating a check of Blueprint requirements for platform identifiers and sample attributes.

A pathogen surveillance group preparing raw sequencing reads for the Sequence Read Archive must determine the correct metadata fields for library layout and instrument model according to Blueprint standards.
Researchers handling human genomic data with phenotypic links aim to submit to dbGaP, focusing on Blueprint-compliant metadata for data use certificates and consent codes.

A multidisciplinary consortium archiving diverse outputs including datasets and presentations in Zenodo needs to identify generic metadata elements for creators and publication dates per the Blueprint.

Proteomics data characterizing host-pathogen interactions is being curated for the PRIDE repository, requiring specific metadata elements for mass spectrometry parameters and protein accession numbers.
Metabolomic profiling results from a clinical cohort are destined for MetaboLights, demanding adherence to Blueprint metadata standards for assay technology and sample extraction methods.
A complex multi-omics study integrating various data types requires a master record in BioStudies, focusing on Blueprint metadata elements that link to subordinate repository entries.
Before data sharing, a clinical trial must be registered on ClinicalTrials.gov, requiring metadata elements for eligibility criteria and primary outcome measures aligned with the Blueprint.
Supplementary figures and raw data tables for a journal article are being shared via Figshare, necessitating Blueprint-compliant metadata for licensing terms and attribution formats.
Underlying data supporting a manuscript on infectious disease dynamics is curated in Dryad, focusing on metadata elements that ensure persistent linkage to the publication DOI.
Social behavioral data influencing health outcomes in specific populations is submitted to ICPSR, requiring metadata elements regarding confidentiality agreements and variable coding schemes.
Computational epidemiology tools developed during the project are archived via GitHub linked to Zenodo, needing metadata elements for software versioning and dependency specifications.
A pre-registered study protocol for outbreak response is managed on the Open Science Framework, requiring metadata elements that capture workflow stages and contributor roles.
Neuroimaging data related to HIV-associated neurocognitive disorders is submitted to NDAR, focusing on Blueprint metadata standards for image modalities and acquisition parameters.
Viral sequence and epitope data are being organized within the Virus Pathogen Resource, necessitating metadata elements for host species and geographic isolation source.
Specific flow cytometry datasets within the broader ImmPort system require detailed annotation, involving metadata elements for antibody panel design and compensation matrices.
Single-cell RNA sequencing data from immune cell sorting is prepared for GEO, requiring metadata elements for cell type ontologies and tissue dissociation protocols.
Shotgun metagenomics data from environmental samples is being deposited in SRA, focusing on metadata elements describing the biome environment and collection device used.
An institution uses Dataverse to host NIAID-funded data before public release, involving mapping Blueprint Section 1 to institutional metadata blocks for citation and contact information.
